title: Foundational GCN Paper and ICLR 2017 Publication
summary: This community centers on the seminal paper 'Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks' by Thomas N. Kipf and Max Welling. The cluster documents the publication of this work in the proceedings of the 5th International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2017) held in Toulon, France. It establishes the direct authorship and venue relationships for this key contribution to graph neural networks.
key_findings: The paper 'Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks' was authored by Thomas N. Kipf and Max Welling.
This work was published in the Conference Track Proceedings of ICLR 2017.
ICLR 2017 is identified as the 5th International Conference on Learning Representations.
The conference took place in Toulon, France, from April 24-26, 2017.
The paper is cited in the context of knowledge graph reasoning and fact verification literature.
